notes:
A general term for authoritative religious texts regarded as sacred or divinely inspired. Can refer to the Bible, the Quran, Buddhist sutras, or the scriptures of any religion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聖典|せいてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧: teachings of the scriptures
- {聖典|せいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to study the scriptures
- {聖典|せいてん}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: scriptural studies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経典|きょうてん}→経典：24153_kyouten⟧: sutra, religious text — often specifically Buddhist scriptures
- ⟦{聖書|せいしょ}→聖書：17969_seisho⟧: the Bible — specifically the Christian scripture
- {教典|きょうてん}: religious canon — the body of authoritative texts of a particular faith
